summary: A prosody corpus of European Portuguese: two native speakers reading sentences that place a vocative — the name or title used to address someone — at the start, middle or end. One row is one read sentence with its transcript, 216 rows in all. Two speakers and a couple of hundred rows make this a narrow probe of one dialect and one construction, not a general Portuguese board.
notes: CLUL prosody corpus (vocatives in European Portuguese, https://www.clul.ulisboa.pt/en/recurso/vocatives-european-portuguese), 216 audio/text rows from two native Standard European Portuguese speakers reading target sentences with vocative constructions in initial/medial/final position. Dialectal pt-PT coverage, distinct domain from minds14-pt-PT (telephone) and speech-massive-pt-PT (voice-assistant utterances). No license is stated on the HF dataset card or its README front-matter (only task_categories/language/size_categories) — verify usage terms with the CLUL source page before any redistribution beyond benchmarking.
